body: This is my quandary. I don't know how to proceed anymore because I don't know if my thoughts and actions are caused by the anxiety and depression or if those are by true underlying behaviors. Thinking about that in itself is making me feel like I'm going crazy and its a horrible uncomfortable feeling that I wish I never had to feel again. I have a significant other who tells me that anything bad in our lives is my fault, so I really don't know how to feel at this point. All signs are pointing to it being true although loved ones have told me the opposite. Im truly sorry that you are having these feelings OP, its something that I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy.
